static_accumulator.definition: Specimens that occupy a fixed location, do not sustain systematic movement, show zero or minimal outward transfer of resources to other organisms along links, and persist through a combination of initial endowment, passive intake from local sources (cover layer, residue), and/or local reproduction. Movement may be episodic (one or two discrete events), but the organism does not maintain a mobile lifestyle. Complexity may increase with reproductive output and tenure. Incipient transfer behavior (< 5% of holdings) is tolerated within the category pending further observation.
key_traits: zero or episodic movement (one to two discrete events; not sustained mobility)
zero or minimal outward transfer along organism links (< 5% of holdings)
fixed location between movement events
resource holding via endowment and/or passive local intake (from cover layer and/or residue)
local reproduction present in some specimens but not required for membership
complexity increases with reproductive output and tenure length
substrate diversity (fragment or structural); substrate is orthogonal to classification

episodic_relocator.definition: Specimens exhibiting one or more discrete movement events while maintaining otherwise static traits: episodic (not sustained) movement pattern, typically zero outward transfer along links, passive primary intake from cover layer and/or residue, high elevation and/or high gradient position, fixed position between movement events, and local reproduction absent or minimal. Movement is goal-driven or event-triggered, not systemic wandering.
key_traits: one to three discrete movement events (episodic, not sustained; <3 per specimen over tenure)
zero or minimal outward transfer along links (typically 0%)
passive cover-layer or residue intake as dominant source
high elevation (0.97–1.00) and high gradient proximity (0.95–1.00) typical
fixed location between movement events
local reproduction absent or minimal
complexity variable; tenure-dependent; no behavioral escalation despite tenure length
substrate diversity; substrate orthogonal to classification

mobile_exchanger.definition: Specimens exhibiting sustained systematic movement (3 or more discrete events across tenure), coupled with active outward transfer of resources to other organisms along links (> 2% of total intake per interval, or ≥ 1.5% with high movement frequency and complexity ≥ 19) or consistent link-derived resource intake (> 5% of total intake). Movement is frequent and recurring, not episodic. Primary resource intake is from passive sources (cover layer and/or residue) but specimens increasingly incorporate link-derived resources. Reproduction is typically present (1+ descendants) but not required. These specimens occupy positions across the gradient and elevation range, showing no strong positional constraint. Substrate diversity observed; substrate orthogonal to classification. Lower-engagement phenotypes (low transfer rate, cover-layer-dominant, reproductive focus) are tolerated within the category if complexity ≥ 16 and movement events ≥ 9.
key_traits: sustained systematic movement: 3+ discrete events across tenure (range 9–17 events in current interval)
active outward transfer of resources along links: > 2% of total intake per interval (or ≥ 1.5% with complexity ≥ 19 and movement ≥ 10); current interval range 0.6–8.1%
primary intake from passive sources (cover layer 48–81%, residue 18–51%) with secondary link-derived intake (0–1%)
gradient position shows diversity (0.75–0.96 observed in current interval); no strict constraint
elevation typically high (0.93–0.96 observed in current interval)
local reproduction variable (0–6 descendants observed in current interval); reproduction present in most but not all specimens
complexity range 16–31 for expanded cohort; 28–31 dominant in current interval
substrate diversity (fragment and structural); substrate orthogonal to classification
phenotypic variation: high-mobility/high-transfer (i-25586), balanced-intake/robust-transfer (i-24333, i-25329), minimal-transfer/reproductive-focus (i-25657), low-transfer/passive-strategy (i-24768)
mobile_exchanger.notes: Category expanded from 517 to 522 members (five new specimens added this interval: i-24333, i-24768, i-25329, i-25586, i-25657). All five new specimens show sustained movement (9–17 events), complexity 28–31, gradient positions 0.75–0.96, and high elevation (0.93–0.96). Outward transfer rates range 0.6–8.1%, all meeting mobile_exchanger thresholds or falling within acceptable lower-engagement phenotypes. Category remains stable and exclusive source of growth in aggregate tier.

anomalous.definition: Specimens whose behavior does not align with any established category or whose behavior profile suggests a lifestyle distinct from known types. These are held pending accumulation of similar specimens or re-evaluation as categories evolve.
key_traits: i-03417: high outward transfer (11.5% of intake) without reciprocal link-derived intake (0%); residue-dominant resource strategy (55% residue vs. typical 10–37%); low reproduction (1 descendant); minimal link reciprocity despite high redistribution—suggests unidirectional donor role or obligate wealth-shedding behavior.
